description: Source code for the WNUnits class managing game units, including loading unit data, images, and providing access methods.

classes.name: WNUnits
classes.description: Manages game unit data, including loading unit definitions, images, and providing access to unit properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the unit data by loading unit files and images from the filesystem.

methods.name: initialised
methods.description: Returns whether the unit data has been initialized.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of units loaded.

methods.name: unitAtIndex:
methods.description: Returns the WMLTag object representing the unit at the specified index.

methods.name: unitNameAtIndex:
methods.description: Returns the unit's name (id) at the specified index.

methods.name: unitIndexForName:
methods.description: Finds and returns the index of the unit with the specified name.

methods.name: convertIndexArray:
methods.description: Converts an array of unit indices to an array of unit names.

methods.name: convertNameArray:
methods.description: Converts an array of unit names to an array of their indices.

methods.name: getUnitNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all unit names.

methods.name: imageAtIndex:
methods.description: Returns the image associated with the unit at the specified index.

methods.name: scaledImageAtIndex:
methods.description: Returns the scaled image associated with the unit at the specified index.

methods.name: resizeTo:
methods.description: Resizes all scaled images to the specified size.
